candidates.change_summary: Remove the timestamp check to allow fallback to execute even if block.timestamp <= pastBlockTime.
Change the pastBlockTime assignment to block.timestamp + 2, altering the future timestamp requirement.
Change the payout condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0.
Remove the pastBlockTime assignment, so pastBlockTime is never updated and remains at its initial value.
Remove the ether payout block, so balance is never transferred to the caller.
